lines.text: She repeats the same line daily!
I feel like an NPC doing chores.

data.define: A person who seems to follow a routine with no thought.

example.text: I feel like an NPC doing chores.

misuse.text: Don't call your real friend an 'NPC'.
misuse.why: It says they have no personality.

hook.text: She repeats the same line daily!

publish.title: What does "NPC" mean?
publish.value: NPC = Someone acting like a robot. Example: "I feel like an NPC doing chores." (very casual English, US).
